summary.name: triadic_global_reward_scale_null_control
summary.paired_unit: source seed; static/rematched schedules averaged within seed
summary.inference: Student-t intervals across eight independent initializations; no result-dependent stopping
summary.design: 1560 two-alternative-partner needs; c0/c75/global25 × PL/FI × static/rematched × live/silent
summary.interpretation: A near-zero global25-minus-c0 contrast is the predicted null for a state-independent multiplicative reward factor under mean log expected reward. A c75-minus-global25 contrast isolates conflict structure only to the extent that numerical and optimizer effects are negligible.
summary.claim_boundary: Task-level protocol and optimization control only. This does not establish lexical meaning, grammar, cultural transmission, or human language origin.
